description: Defines a template class PriorityQueue implementing a priority queue with erasure capabilities, including nested Pointer class for element references, supporting operations like insert, erase, and traversal based on priority and FIFO order.

classes.name: PriorityQueue
classes.description: A thread-safe, priority-based queue supporting insertion, erasure, and traversal, with debug-mode validation.

classes.name: PriorityQueue::Pointer
classes.description: A handle to an element in PriorityQueue, allowing validation and comparison.

methods.name: Insert
methods.description: Insert a value with a specified priority into the queue, returning a Pointer to the element.

methods.name: InsertAtFront
methods.description: Insert a value at the front of the list for a given priority, returning a Pointer.

methods.name: Erase
methods.description: Remove an element from the queue given its Pointer, returning the erased value.

methods.name: FirstMin
methods.description: Get a Pointer to the first element of the lowest priority.

methods.name: LastMin
methods.description: Get a Pointer to the last element of the lowest priority.

methods.name: FirstMax
methods.description: Get a Pointer to the first element of the highest priority.

methods.name: LastMax
methods.description: Get a Pointer to the last element of the highest priority.

methods.name: GetNextTowardsLastMin
methods.description: Get the next element towards the last min element in priority order.

methods.name: GetPreviousTowardsFirstMax
methods.description: Get the previous element towards the first max element in priority order.

methods.name: FindIf
methods.description: Find the first element matching a predicate.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clear all elements from the queue.
